name: Strawberry Pizza
notes: Also, you may add other fruits to the strawberries to make a beautiful pattern.

steps.title: Make the crust
steps.body: Cut together **1½ cubes butter**, **1½ cups flour** and **½ cup powdered sugar**. Press into a pan and bake at 325°F for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Make the cheese topping
steps.body: Blend together **8 oz cream cheese, softened**, **⅓ cup sugar** and **1 egg**.

steps.title: Bake the cheese topping
steps.body: Place on a warm crust, and bake at 250°F for another 10-12 minutes. Cool.

steps.title: Arrange the strawberries
steps.body: For strawberry topping, place in a beautiful pattern on top of cooled sweet cheese topping: **1 basket strawberries, cut as desired**.

steps.title: Make the glaze
steps.body: Cook, stirring until thick and clear: **1 basket strawberries, crushed**, **2 Tbsp corn starch**, **½ cup water** and **⅔ cup sugar**. Then pour over the strawberries.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Cool and serve, with whipped topping if desired.
